'''Triage''' was a department within the [[Analysis (Alliance Intelligence)|Analysis]] office of the [[Intentions]] branch of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]]. Triage was created with one goal; to pre-judge incoming intelligence information on its potential useful, discarding and filing data that appeared to not be immediately relevant or important. While vital information was undoubtedly overlooked, the system ensured that the Analysis office could function without losing itself under the gigabits of information they had to analyze.
